Hi Jonas (and Lauren),

Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday — Synergy Labs would love to co-host a three-part virtual webinar series and coordinate a shared booth presence for the Q1 regional roadshows. High-level ask below:

- Three 45-min webinars (EMEA, US, APAC friendly times) between Feb–Apr.
- Shared 10x10 booth at two west-coast shows (San Francisco + Seattle) with split onsite staffing and logos.
- MDF request: $45k total to cover display, collateral, and paid promotion split 50/50.

We can provide the event microsite, a dedicated registration page, and social promos. Attached is a short timeline and estimated cost table to start (Synergy_Series_Timeline_v1.pdf).

Would Redwood be open to:
1) a 50/50 MDF split with co-branded landing page and joint email send?
2) committing one AE + one Solutions Engineer for the booth days per show?

If that sounds reasonable I can draft an ops checklist and a sponsorship term sheet. Happy to jump on a 30-min call next week to lock dates.

Best,
Ella Thompson
Partnerships & Events
Synergy Labs

2) Staffing: we can commit 1 AE + 1 SE per show but will need to confirm exact names once travel budgets are finalized. We can also offer an on-stage product demo slot (10 minutes) per webinar if you want.

Proposed mutual action plan (short):
- This week: Synergy to send term sheet + high-level creative assets (logo files, hero headshots).
- By Nov 18: Redwood to share preferred webinar dates and tentative booth staff names.
- Nov 20–24: ops sync (30 min) to align comms calendar and paid promotion cadence.

Cc'ing Lauren, Sergio, and Marissa to scope the demand-gen and field ops side. Sergio — can you draft a shared booth resource rota (xlsx) with estimated travel nights? Marissa — can you assess if we have budget to front any of the promo spend before MDF clears?

I can take point on the MOU and HubSpot deal. If that works, Ella — we can schedule the ops sync next Wednesday (Nov 20) 10:00 PT.

Thanks,
